purpose: Coupled water passenger resurfacing, sinking, floating lifetime, request/approach continuation and explicit no-op, using existing shared delivery initializers and water boarding.

inputs: One PassengerStoneSlot with current water ActorType and separate persistent ActorRenderHistory; raw velocity word and cached pixels are inputs, not reconstructed positions.
Water surface, one/two craft cached X/Y, raw vertical velocity and carried kind; ten-platform occupancy address domain.
Registered immutable idle/request/left/right animations, period and floating lifetime; current type identity is one of1/3/5.
outputs: Updated typed slot and ordered field/index/value journal; next initializer/boarding action, selected craft and failure.
No score/item/audio/benefit writes here. Existing delivery/itinerary own their immediate continuations.
effects: Resurfacing initialization clears source occupancy/overlay, initializes animation and raw velocity. Resurfacing integrates a clamped raw accumulator and can snap to surface then float.
Sinking integrates an unclamped wrapping raw word, uses unsigned Y threshold1800h and retires through descriptor+2C=IgnoreActorState1C0E.

Floating always ticks/frames, optionally corrects surface Y, scans eligible craft except water identity3, and decrements its lifetime only if no request was selected. Destination/question/approach preserve their original conditional animation and exact cached-X equality.
preconditions: Ordinary disjoint RAM/resources/stack, physical actor below16; one/two players and ten platforms; all scalar words/histories otherwise arbitrary. No initialization reachability or sign/positive-timer assumption.

Bridge admits DS=DGROUP, CS=GAME, even actor byte index<32 and checked water descriptor identity/callbacks/land-pair word. Initializers use transient READ_JOURNEY context even if the stored handler word is stale.

Source is below10 with paired doubled index only for resurfacing initialization and approach; destination is below10 with paired doubled index for approach because it can board immediately. Other dormant logical/byte fields remain arbitrary.

Updating entries have four immutable nonempty registered vectors; terminal word starts inside [0E20,1020), at most255 live words. Any available live/terminal cursor is admitted when read; due FFFE wrapping to0 is retained. Invalid vectors/cursors/descriptors/indices retain explicit L1 fallback before publication.

Normal immediate tails consume the parent journal at a matching pre-callee cut. DESTINATION and BOARD bind native selected craft to DI; native selected results are also independently observed. No parent pre-tail snapshot is compared with child poststate.
No-op2195 is valid for arbitrary registers and requires no slot/world pointer.

callers: DispatchActorUpdates scans physical slots in order. Existing land waiting/request/approach water-swap tails enter resurfacing after selecting the water pair.
Water descriptor callback table is the complete indirect action/update set. Shared request/approach initializers and water boarding remain owned by passenger_delivery.

bridge: IgnoreActorState (stored retirement, not an immediate call)

indirect.classification: Checked descriptor targets, journal completion, no duplicate tail, selected craft range/equality and matching-cut projection. No register/flag liveness elimination.

owned: Current phase, animation cursor/countdown, sprite/overlay, X/Y, raw vertical motion; floating_ticks or request_ticks only in their valid phases.
Source platform occupancy clear is an indexed output event; geometry and occupancy storage retain their existing owners.
borrowed: Immutable current water type geometry/resources and identities; craft snapshots and water surface.
Every renderer history survives; only current cached pixels are borrowed. No recomputation/reset on projection.
memory.aliases: Existing phase table unchanged: FLOATING reads floating_ticks; floating destination/question read request_ticks; approach/resurfacing/sinking read neither. Raw velocity is the existing independent vertical_motion field. Initializers write newly active members before use; inactive members are never serialized.

assumptions: B is actual-C split output, native/RAM frame and dependence with checked literal coverage and orchestration. Uniform selected-slot0 normalization is accompanied by arbitrary-other-RAM-byte frame; compiled cases vary all16 slots.

Tick/frame caller seams allow arbitrary shared outputs and assert all input/vector equalities. Independent actual primitives discharge them. Append at arbitrary prefix discharges sparse dependence/hidden-owned-cell frame summaries; native callers never read journal payload.
Full projection predicate has independent output/frame/dependence/corruption properties. Stage owned outputs plus all-other-byte frames establish its conjunction at each matching cut.
L0-to-L1 remains separate differential C/D, including complete retained machine registers where defined, RAM/devices/order. This is not a matching-DOS-byte claim.
eliminated: Ordinary native code has no registers, original addresses, RAM accessor or dispatch model. It returns typed writes and named immediate actions.
No machine detail is assumed dead: retained generated shell carries all registers/flags and checks every published native value/order.
retained: Velocity is a raw word integrated with arithmetic SAR6, including negative rounding, word overflow and signed clamps E800..1800 during resurfacing only.
The first resurfacing test is JS of wrapped cachedY-anchor-water, with positive CH=1 retained by the machine shell. Crossing uses signed SAR5(newY)-anchor versus water and includes equality.
Surface correction compares cachedY itself with water; equality suppresses the store even if position is stale. Sinking Y<1800 is unsigned and velocity has no clamp.

Floating scans stationary, empty craft at wrapped exact Y=water-18; approach omits the stationary check; destination checks only that either craft is at that height, even if busy. First candidate order is preserved.
Only second water identity77FE skips floating rescue search. Forced direct request/approach entry for that identity retains DOS behavior; no global prohibition is invented.
Lifetime decrements only after no candidate, with0->FFFF and1->0 sink. Request counters have the same wrap. Zero animation periods/countdown wraps and sentinel retry are retained.
Sinking installs common no-op1C0E, not2195. Water2195 belongs to descriptor+24/+26 and has no normal caller after rescue pairs to land.

evidence.property: Literal branch coverage and cross-unit target inventory
evidence.method: Actual output plus independent native/RAM byte frames and dependence cover all owned and retained state, full machine registers/flags/store order, next/selected/failure. Frame-full varies every unborrowed slot field, including phase for phase-agnostic reused helpers. Actual primitive tick/frame/append theorems discharge shared arbitrary-output seams with asserted input equality. Literal partitions and exact native branch order compose at the journal and pre-tail cut; complete projection has independent actual-code properties. Append at arbitrary prefix lifts zero-prefix stage checks, and native callers do not read hidden payload. Closed delivery/itinerary transitions compose through actual exported bridge entries; normal second-pair and no-op reachability is separately audited.
